accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.intro: The company's chart of accounts and cost centres. Every accounting movement is recorded against a detail account.

setup.title: Set up your accounting
setup.intro: Before recording entries you need to choose the starting chart of accounts and open the first fiscal year (twelve monthly periods). You can then add sub-accounts, rename or deactivate them.
setup.needAdmin: Your organisation's accounting is not set up yet. Ask an administrator to set it up.
setup.chartEmpty: Empty: I will build it account by account
setup.fiscalYearHint: Twelve open monthly periods are created, from January to December.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.parentHint: Leave empty for a root account. A detail account without movements becomes a group account when you add a sub-account to it.
accounts.codeHint: Only numbers separated by dots, for example 6.

costCenters.title: Cost centres
costCenters.intro: A cost centre lets you see the trial balance and ledger by department, branch or line of business. It is assigned to each line of an entry.
costCenters.empty: There are no cost centres yet.

journal.intro: The journal. A draft can be edited; a posted entry is never touched again: if there is a mistake, it is reversed.
journal.empty: There are no entries with those filters.

entry.intro: Record the entry with double entry: the sum of the debits must equal the sum of the credits.
entry.readonlyIntro: Posted entry: read only. To correct it, reverse the entry.
entry.deleteConfirm: The draft is deleted completely. A posted entry can never be deleted.
entry.reverseIntro: An entry with the debits and credits swapped is created and posted. The original stays as it was, marked as reversed.
entry.reverseDateHint: By default, the entry's date. If its period is already closed, enter a date in an open period.
entry.isReversal: This entry is the reversal of another one.
entry.autoOrigin: This entry was generated by the system from: {source}. To correct it, reverse the entry (or fix the source document).

sourceTypes.withholding: a withholding issued to a supplier
sourceTypes.purchase_bill_void: the cancellation of a purchase bill
sourceTypes.receipt_void: the cancellation of a customer receipt

periods.intro: Closing a period prevents posting with a date inside it. They are closed in order and reopened from the latest backwards.

reports.intro: Trial balance: opening balance, movement and closing balance per account. Click the code of a detail account to see its ledger.
reports.ledgerIntro: The account's ledger, with the running balance line by line.
reports.noMovements: The account has no movements in that range.
reports.empty: There are no movements in that range.

auto.intro: Invoices, credit notes, their cancellations and stock movements turn into journal entries by themselves. Here you decide how.
auto.offWarning: Automatic posting is off: whatever arrives stays pending and can be posted once you turn it on.

settings.title: Settings
settings.enabledHint: When off, documents wait under “Pending” (they are not lost). It turns itself off if you deactivate the module.
settings.fromHint: Documents before this date are not posted automatically: load them as opening balances. Empty = everything that arrives.

payment.title: Where it is collected
payment.intro: If the invoice carries a payment method, it is collected immediately and goes to cash or bank; if it carries none, it stays receivable from the customer.

roles.title: Which account each rule uses
roles.intro: The rules do not know account codes: they use roles. Pick which account of your chart carries each role; if you change one, the account that had it lets it go. A role without an account (in red) leaves the documents that need it pending.
roles.futureIntro: No rule uses them yet; leave them as they are or assign them if you already know which account it will be.

hints.sales_returns: Debit of each credit note (excluding VAT)
hints.other_income: Credit of each debit note (excluding VAT)
hints.vat_payable: Credit for the VAT on sales; debit on credit notes
hints.bank: Invoices collected by card or transfer
hints.inventory: Debited on restocking, credited on each sale
hints.cogs: Debit for what the goods sold cost
hints.retained_earnings: Counterpart of the opening stock balance
hints.payables: Debit of each issued withholding (lowers what is owed to the supplier)
hints.income_tax_withholding_payable: Credit of the income tax withheld from suppliers
hints.vat_withholding_payable: Credit of the VAT withheld from suppliers

pending.title: Pending
pending.intro: Documents that should have produced an entry and could not. Fix the cause (open the period, assign the role…) and retry: nothing is lost.
pending.retried: {posted} posted, {still} still pending, {discarded} no longer apply.
pending.discardIntro: Use it for what must not be posted, for example because it is already in the opening balances. It is recorded with your reason.

reasons.PERIOD_NOT_FOUND: There is no fiscal year for that date
reasons.ACCOUNT_NOT_POSTABLE: The account does not accept movements
reasons.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Currency differs from the accounting currency
reasons.ORIGINAL_NOT_POSTED: The invoice has no entry yet

statements.intro: Balance sheet and income statement built from the posted entries, with comparison against another date or period.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.historyEmpty: You don't have any conversations yet. History is stored on the server and is never lost.
assistant.deleteHint: It will no longer appear in your history. Anything the assistant already did in the system is not undone.
assistant.placeholder: Ask me something. Enter to send.
assistant.emptyHint: Ask about your data or tell me to do something. Before creating or changing anything, I will ask you to confirm.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant can only do what you can do, and never writes anything without your confirmation.

examples.sales: How much did I invoice this month?
examples.role: Create a cashier role that can only issue invoices
examples.customer: Do I have any customer without an email?

detail.title: Event details
detail.redactedNotice: Sensitive data (tokens, access links, passwords) is stored redacted.
detail.truncatedNotice: The original event was too large: only the main fields were kept.
detail.noPayload: This event stored no additional data.

audit.empty: No activity recorded with these filters

event.treasury_receivable_credited: Credit note applied to a customer debt
event.treasury_receivable_overdue: Payment reminder sent to a customer

audit.subtitle: Who did what, when and from where. Read-only.
audit.title: Audit log

auth.descriptionLogin: Lost access to OneAuth? Worry not. Set up passphrase and backup number to recover OneAuth easily.
auth.descriptionRegister: Go back to sign in with your existing account.
auth.noInviteToken: The invitation token was not found.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
auth.setNewPassword: Create a new password for your account
auth.setPasswordToJoin: Set a password to join the organization

certificates.encryptedHint: The file and password are stored encrypted. They are never shown again after upload.
certificates.intro: Required to sign and have your invoices authorized by the tax authority. Without an active certificate, invoices are still issued commercially, but they never get authorized.
certificates.title: Digital certificate

customers.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable {name}?
customers.disableHint: The customer will become inactive but will not be deleted from the database.
customers.nameRequired: Name or legal name is required
customers.searchLabel: Search by name, ID or email
customers.title: Customers

employees.cannotEditEstablishments: You cannot change this account's establishments.
employees.cannotEditOwnRoles: You cannot change your own roles.
employees.cannotEditOwnerRoles: You cannot change the roles of the organization owner.
employees.restoreIntro: An email will be sent to {email} with a one-time link so that {name} can reset their password.
employees.restoreSent: Email sent. The link expires in 2 hours.
employees.title: Employees

establishments.idHint: The establishment (id: {id}) and the emission point you choose above are the ones you need when issuing an invoice.
establishments.intro: Required to issue invoices — every invoice is issued from a specific emission point.
establishments.noPoints: This establishment has no emission points yet
establishments.pairHint: On the POS, open "Set up POS" and enter this code:
establishments.pickOne: Pick an establishment to see its emission points
establishments.posHint: Once created, it will show a rotating 6-digit code to pair the physical register.
establishments.title: Establishments and emission points
establishments.unlinkConfirm: Unlink "{name}"? The paired POS will no longer sync until it is set up again with a new code.

fiscal.title: SRI status

statusHint.pending: It is being signed and sent to the SRI.
statusHint.sent: The SRI received it and has not authorized it yet. This usually takes a few seconds.
statusHint.authorized: The SRI authorized this document. It is valid for tax purposes.
statusHint.rejected: The SRI rejected it. Fix the data and issue a new invoice.
statusHint.error: It could not be delivered to the SRI.

fiscal.none: This invoice does not have an electronic document yet.
fiscal.autoRetry: It will be retried automatically on {when}.
fiscal.needsAction: It will not be retried on its own: fix the problem and press "Retry delivery".
fiscal.voidedWarning: This invoice is voided in the system. If the SRI authorizes it, you will need to issue a credit note or void it in SRI en línea.

batchResults.title: Activation finished
batchResults.summary: {activated} modules activated and {failed} could not be activated.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust stock
adjustDialog.quantityHint: Positive amount. You pick the direction above.
adjustDialog.reasonCodeHint: This reason picks the accounting account. It is not a note.
adjustDialog.unitCostHint: Only when the entry carries a real outside cost. Leave blank to use the current average.
adjustDialog.noteHint: Free text for humans. It decides nothing in accounting.
adjustDialog.invalidQuantity: Quantity must be a number greater than zero, up to 4 decimals.

inventory.deactivateBody: Warehouse {name} will stop showing up. The stock ledger history stays untouched. If any stock is left, the server will refuse.
inventory.intro: Stock on hand per product and warehouse, with average cost.
inventory.productFilterHint: The list is paginated on the server: to search, pick a product.

stale.title: These figures are not reliable
stale.body: Inventory was switched off between {from} and {to}. Sales kept happening and {count} movements went unrecorded.
stale.action: Run a physical count and load it as an adjustment with reason Physical count. The warning clears itself.

inventory.title: Inventory

warehouseDialog.codeHint: Cannot be changed later: it is written on every stock ledger row.
warehouseDialog.establishmentHint: Sales from this establishment will draw down this warehouse.
warehouseDialog.isDefaultHint: Takes sales whose establishment has no warehouse of its own.

inventory.warehousesIntro: Every establishment gets its warehouse automatically. Add the rest here.

invoices.priceRequired: Invalid price: use a number greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals
invoices.addLineFirst: Add at least one product line to issue the invoice.
invoices.certEncryptedHint: The file and password are stored encrypted.
invoices.confirmCustomerFirst: Select a customer to start adding products.
invoices.createEstablishmentHint: It is created along with a "Main" emission point so you can issue right away.
invoices.creditNoteError: Could not issue the credit note
invoices.creditNoteHint: Reverses the full invoice amount without voiding it. A reason is required by the tax authority.
invoices.debitNoteError: Could not issue the debit note
invoices.debitNoteHint: Charges an extra amount on the invoice (late-payment interest, collection fees) without changing its amount. Each motive is a line of the document.
invoices.issueNote: Once issued, the invoice is sent as an electronic document and can no longer be edited.
invoices.linesPlaceholder: The lines you add will appear here.
invoices.needEstablishmentHint: You need to create at least one {field} to issue.
invoices.noCertificateHint: You have no active digital certificate — the invoice will still be issued, but the tax authority will never authorize it until you upload one.
invoices.noEmissionPoints: This establishment has no active emission points.
invoices.notDraftAnymore: This invoice is no longer a draft and cannot be edited.
invoices.searchCustomer: Search customer by name or ID
invoices.step3Subtitle: Review the totals and send to {authority}.
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.step3SubtitleGeneric: Review the totals and issue the invoice.

withholdings.intro: Withholding documents you issue to your suppliers when you pay a purchase. They are signed and sent to the SRI.
withholdings.formIntro: Withhold income tax and/or VAT from a supplier. Once sent to the SRI it cannot be edited: if you make a mistake it is voided at the SRI and another is issued.
withholdings.empty: You have not issued any withholdings yet.
withholdings.supportHint: The supplier invoice (or other document) you are withholding on.
withholdings.retainedHint: Pick the withholding code: it brings its percentage, which you can correct. The withheld amount is calculated for you.
withholdings.submit: Issue and send to the SRI

guides.intro: Delivery guides that cover the transport of your goods. They are issued before the goods leave.
guides.formIntro: Say who carries the goods, where they leave from and who receives them. It carries no amounts or taxes.
guides.empty: You have not issued any delivery guides yet.
guides.originHint: If left empty, the address of the issuing establishment is used or, if it has none, the head office address.
guides.submit: Issue and send to the SRI

receivables.intro: What each customer owes the company. A debt is created automatically from an invoice on credit; point-of-sale and cash sales are not included.

receipts.intro: Money coming in from customers and the debts it is applied to. A receipt starts as a draft and, once posted, gets its number, reduces the debt and creates its journal entry.
receipts.search: Search by number, reference or customer
receipts.receivedHint: What goes into cash or the bank. Can be 0 if only an advance is used.
receipts.excessHint: What is left becomes a customer advance and can be used in a later receipt.
receipts.accountHint: The account that receives the money.
receipts.formIntro: Pick the customer: their open debts appear and what you collect is split oldest first.
receipts.formEditIntro: Edit the draft. A posted receipt is no longer edited: it is voided and redone.
receipts.noDebts: This customer has no open debts: what you collect will become an advance.
receipts.useAdvancesHint: You can use an advance from an earlier receipt: no new money comes in.
receipts.noLines: It was not applied to any debt: everything collected became an advance.
receipts.voidedText: Reason: {reason}. Voided on {when}. The debts got their balance back and accounting reversed the entry.
receipts.draftNote: This receipt is a draft: it has no number yet, does not reduce any debt and creates no journal entry.
receipts.voidHint: The debts get their balance back and accounting reverses the entry. Nothing is deleted: it stays in the history with your reason.

errors.cash: The amount received is not valid.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.overBalance: It is more than the debt balance.
errors.overAdvance: It is more than what is left of the advance.
errors.applyTooMuch: What is applied to the debts is more than what was collected plus the advances.
errors.nothing: Enter the amount received or an advance to use.

reminders.intro: Email your customers when they have overdue documents. One email per customer, with the list, and at most one per document per week.
reminders.externalNotice: This is an email that reaches YOUR CUSTOMER, signed with your company name. That is why it starts off: it is only sent if you turn it on here, and every change is recorded in the audit log.
reminders.enable: Send payment reminders to my customers
reminders.enableHint: Sent once a day, from 09:00 in your time zone.
reminders.firstAfterDaysHint: A document is reminded once it has been overdue at least this many days.
reminders.repeatEveryDaysHint: Minimum 7: a document is not reminded more than once a week.

errors.firstAfterDays: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
errors.repeatEveryDays: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max} (at least a week).

reminders.todayHint: This list sends nothing: it shows what would go out if the process ran now. It works even when reminders are off, so you can decide before turning them on.
reminders.runWithoutEmail: {n} customer(s) without an email received nothing.
reminders.runAlready: {n} customer(s) had already been reminded today.
reminders.withoutEmail: {n} customer(s) have no email on file: they would receive nothing. Add their email in the customer record.
reminders.empty: No customer has documents due for a reminder today.
reminders.confirmEnableText: From now on, customers with overdue debt will receive an email on behalf of your company: the first one after {first} days overdue and then every {repeat} days until they pay. You can turn it off any time.
reminders.confirmRunText: An email will be sent to {customers} customer(s) for {documents} overdue document(s). This cannot be undone.

aging.intro: What is current and what is overdue, by days past due.

statement.customerAdvancesHint: They do not count in the net: they live in «customer advances».
statement.intro: Their debts, what has been applied to them and what they owe today.
statement.creditLimitHint: Empty = no limit. Informational: it does not block invoicing.
statement.termsHint: The days apply to invoices issued from now on; debts already open keep their due date.
statement.empty: This customer has no debts in receivables.

opening.intro: Load what each customer already owed before you started using receivables.
opening.noEntryTitle: This does not create a journal entry
opening.noEntry: Opening balances go into receivables, not the general ledger. For receivables to match accounting, record the opening journal entry in accounting for the same total.
opening.confirmText: {n} debt(s) totalling {total} will be loaded with cut-off date {date}. This load cannot be repeated for that date.

errors.dueDate: The due date is not valid.
errors.dueBeforeIssue: The due date cannot be before the issue date.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

suppliers.intro: Who you buy from. The ID cannot be changed once the supplier is created; suppliers are not deleted, they are deactivated.
suppliers.identificationLocked: It cannot be changed: orders and withholdings already cite it. If it was wrong, deactivate this supplier and create another.
suppliers.creditDaysHint: 0 = cash. Proposed on each order and can be changed.
suppliers.empty: You have not registered any suppliers yet.

orders.intro: The purchase commitment with each supplier. A sent order is not edited: it is cancelled with a reason. Depending on the amount it may need another person's approval.
orders.reopened: The order is a draft again.
orders.pendingHint: Waiting for another person's approval: whoever prepared the order does not approve it.
orders.rejectedHint: It was rejected: {reason}. Reopen it as a draft, fix it and send it again.
orders.byPolicy: by policy: approval was not required for this amount

form.newIntro: Prepare the order as a draft; when sent it is numbered and, if the amount requires it, waits for approval.
form.editIntro: Only a draft can be edited.
form.onlyDraft: Only an order in draft can be edited.

settings.title: Approval policy
settings.intro: Decide from what amount an order needs another person's approval. Without approval, orders are approved when sent.
settings.thresholdHint: Orders of this value or more wait for approval. 0 = all.
settings.overReceiptHint: How much more than ordered may be received. In basis points: 100 = 1%. 0 = no over-receipt.
settings.toleranceHint: Tolerance accepted when matching invoices, in basis points: 100 = 1%. 0 = no tolerance.

receiving.title: Goods receipt
receiving.intro: Ordered, received and already invoiced for each line. A receipt is not edited: a mistake is fixed with an inventory adjustment.
receiving.dialogIntro: Record what arrived. It enters the order warehouse at the order cost.
receiving.nothingPending: Nothing is left to receive on this order.
receiving.overHint: This is more than pending: it is only accepted within the tolerance the company set.
receiving.noLines: Enter the quantity of at least one line.
receiving.closeHint: Treats the rest as final: the supplier will not send it. The order is closed.
receiving.closedHint: Closed: no more goods are expected.

receipts.intro: Every delivery recorded against an order. Goods enter the warehouse with their cost.
receipts.search: Search by number or delivery note
receipts.empty: No receipts match those filters yet.

bills.intro: The invoices your suppliers issued to you. They are matched against what was ordered and received before posting.
bills.search: Search by number, document or supplier
bills.empty: No purchase invoices match those filters.

reasons.QTY_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED: More is invoiced than was received.
reasons.PRICE_VARIANCE: The price does not match the order.
reasons.LINE_NOT_IN_ORDER: The line is not on the order.

bills.noOrderHint: Without an order the invoice is not matched against what was received.
bills.noOrderForbidden: Billing without a purchase order skips the three-way match: only an administrator can do it. Pick the order or ask for the permission.
bills.loadFromOrder: Loaded what was received and not yet invoiced from the order.
bills.nothingToBill: This order has no received goods left to invoice.
bills.supplierTotalHint: Optional. If it differs from the calculated total by more than 1 cent the server rejects it.
bills.expenseHintHelp: Lines without a product only. Example: 5.2.04
bills.invalidDocument: Complete the supplier document: 3 digits, 3 digits and 9 digits.
bills.invalidLines: Check the lines: description, quantity and cost.
bills.blockedNow: The invoice does not match the order and was blocked. Review the reasons.
bills.overrideHint: You accept the difference from the order. Your name and the reason are recorded; the price difference is booked separately in accounting.
bills.matchOk: Matches what was received and the order price.
bills.matchNone: No purchase order: there is nothing to match against.
bills.blockedHint: Blocked: it is not posted until it is corrected or someone else approves it with an exception.
bills.withholdHint: Opens the withholding form with this invoice's data. You choose the codes and percentages. The invoice is marked "withheld" on its own once the SRI authorizes the document.
bills.onlyDraft: A bill can only be edited while it is a draft or blocked.

organization.certificateCardHint: Required for the tax authority to authorize your invoices.

help.legalName: The exact registered name of your company. It is the one printed on tax documents.
help.tradeName: The name your customers know you by, if it differs from the legal name. Optional.
help.taxId: Your organization's tax identifier. Electronic invoicing cannot be issued without it.

organization.settingsIntro: Your organization's tax details. They are used to issue invoices and in the company profile. The tax ID and country are required to issue electronic documents.

sriProfile.title: Tax details for the SRI

sriProfile.withholdingAgentHint: Resolution number, if the SRI designated you as a withholding agent.
sriProfile.mainAddressHint: If empty, the issuing establishment address is used.
sriProfile.defaultPaymentMethodHint: Declared to the SRI when the invoice does not specify another one.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Tell us what happened. The more specific, the faster we can find it.
report.label: What happened?
report.placeholder: For example: adding the second line of an invoice does nothing.
report.includeActivity: Include my latest steps in the app
report.includeActivityHint: Which screens I opened and which calls the app made (for example “POST /invoices/:id/lines → 400”), without what I typed in the fields.
report.privacy: Do not write passwords or keys.
report.sentBody: Thank you. If you talk to support, give them this code:
report.notSent: This environment does not send reports (telemetry is off).
report.error: The report could not be sent. Please try again.

restaurant.title: Restaurant
restaurant.noEstablishment: Your organisation has no establishment yet. Create one before setting up the restaurant.
restaurant.setupError: The venue could not be set up.
restaurant.loadError: The restaurant data could not be loaded.

tables.title: Tables
tables.intro: Your venue's tables. Create them here and place them on the floor plan afterwards.
tables.emptyTitle: How many tables do you have?
tables.emptyIntro: Tell us how many tables you have and how many guests they seat and we'll create them for you. You can rename them and place each one on your floor plan later.
tables.name: Table name
tables.deactivateBody: Table “{name}” will no longer be available. It is not deleted: it keeps its id and its reservations, and you can reactivate it.
tables.planCardIntro: This is the floor plan you saved. Draw or change the layout in the editor.
tables.planCardEmpty: You haven't drawn your venue yet.

tableForm.nameRequired: Enter a name for the table.
tableForm.capacityInvalid: The maximum cannot be lower than the minimum.
tableForm.capacityHint: Seats between the minimum and the maximum number of guests.

bulk.title: How many tables do you have?
bulk.intro: We create the tables all at once. You can rename them and place them on the floor plan afterwards.
bulk.prefixHint: They are numbered after the tables that already exist.

plan.title: Floor plan
plan.intro: Draw the walls, place the tables and mark the zones. The draft is saved only in this browser until you press “Save”.
plan.roomIntro: The four walls are created at once. The measurement is in metres.
plan.wallHint: Click to start; each click chains another wall at a right angle and snaps to nearby corners and walls. Type a length to set it. Esc finishes.
plan.wallTouchHint: Drawing walls needs a bigger screen; use the phone to move and place tables.
plan.emptyCanvas: Your venue is empty. Start with “Room” to draw the walls.
plan.draftNotice: You have an unsaved draft of this floor plan.
plan.loadError: The floor plan could not be loaded.
plan.conflictTitle: Someone else changed the floor plan
plan.conflictBody: Someone saved changes before you. You can reload the floor plan (you will lose your draft) or copy yours first so you don't lose it.
plan.conflictCopied: Floor plan copied. You can reload now.
plan.leaveBody: If you leave now, this draft stays in the browser but won't have been saved to the server.
plan.saveError: The floor plan could not be saved.
plan.invalidPlan: The floor plan is not valid. Check the marked tables.

issues.title: Warnings
issues.narrowAisles: {count} tables with a narrow aisle (under 60 cm)
issues.looseWalls: Walls not joined: {count}. They almost touch another wall.

inspector.empty: Select a table, a zone or an element to see and change its details.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.label: Label
inspector.zoneStructure: The zone's area is drawn around its tables: assign tables to it to see it.
inspector.deleteHint: Removing from the plan does not delete the table: it deactivates it and keeps its id.
inspector.wallDragHint: Drag the wall to move it: walls that reach it follow, and everything stays joined.
inspector.floorSizeHint: Width and length of the room, in meters.

schedule.title: Opening hours
schedule.intro: When your venue opens and how often you offer a table. The preview is the proof that it was set up correctly.
schedule.shiftsIntro: Per weekday. You can have several shifts on the same day (for example, midday and evening).
schedule.label: Label
schedule.durationsIntro: How long the table is held depending on how many people come.
schedule.saveError: The schedule could not be saved.
schedule.exceptionsIntro: One-off dates that break the usual pattern: a closed day or special hours.
schedule.previewIntro: Pick a date and see the shifts the customer will see when booking.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.intro: Who is coming today, how many they are and at which table. Add phone bookings and mark when guests are seated.
reservations.empty: There are no reservations for this day.
reservations.completed: Reservation completed: the table is free.
reservations.noShown: Marked as no-show: the table is free.
reservations.cancelled: Reservation cancelled: the tables are free.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel reservation
cancelDialog.body: Cancel the reservation for {name} at {time} ({party} guests)? The tables will be freed.
cancelDialog.noEmail: They did not leave an email: let them know by phone.

dialog.title: New reservation
dialog.closed: The restaurant is closed that day.
dialog.noSlots: No free tables for that group on that day. Try another day or pick the tables by hand.
dialog.slotFull: No free table at that time
dialog.guestEmailHint: With an email, the guest gets a confirmation and a link to cancel.
dialog.manualTablesHint: Otherwise the system picks the tightest-fitting table, or joins several for a large group.

settings.title: Booking page
settings.intro: The page where your customers book on their own, at any hour. Share it on social media, on Google or at the door.
settings.notReady: Before turning it on, finish setting up the venue: with no opening hours or tables there is nothing to offer.
settings.enabledOff: Off: the page is unavailable. You can still add reservations yourself.
settings.name: Name your customers will see
settings.linkHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. If you change it, the old link stops working.
settings.phoneHint: Shown to customers with large groups or questions.
settings.notifyEmailHint: You get a notice here for every online booking or cancellation.
settings.noteHint: Shown on the page. For example: 15-minute grace period, dress code…
settings.rulesIntro: These limits apply to online bookings. You can add reservations beyond them yourself.
settings.maxTablesHint: A large group can take several tables together, up to this number.
settings.daysAheadHint: How many days ahead customers can book.
settings.noticeHint: How long before the time a booking must be made.

hello.title: Welcome aboard!
hello.desc: Before you start we need a few details so you get full control of your CRM. Two short steps, under a minute.

form.title: Your details
form.desc: Fill in your name and your identification. Each label has a ? that explains what it is for.

submit.title: Save and continue
submit.desc: Saving takes you to your organization's details.

intro.title: Now, your organization
intro.desc: It is the company your invoices are issued under and the one your team belongs to. Each field has a ? with the detail.

submit.title: Save and enter
submit.desc: Saving takes you into the CRM, where we show you the rest.

welcome.title: Welcome back
welcome.desc: We'll walk you through the key areas of your CRM so you get off to a great start. You can exit anytime and relaunch the guide from your avatar menu.

home.title: Home
home.desc: This is your dashboard: at a glance you see active customers, employees, products and invoices.

menu.title: Side menu
menu.desc: Navigate between modules from here. Each module appears according to your permissions and your organization's active plugins.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.desc: Define roles with specific permissions: Admin, Sales Rep, Accountant… Each account is assigned one or more roles, which determine what they can see and do.

employees.title: Employees
employees.desc: Invite your team from here: assign an email, a role, and establishments. The person receives an email with a link to activate their account and start using the CRM.

customers.title: Customers
customers.desc: Manage your contacts and accounts: this is where your buyers are registered.

products.title: Products
products.desc: Your product catalog, categories and units of measure. This is what you'll invoice.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.desc: Issue and manage your electronic invoicing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Set up your account, organization, establishments and certificate from this view.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.desc: Activate the extra modules your organization needs here.

finish.title: All set!
finish.desc: You know the essentials now. If anything slips your mind, press the help icon at the top right to see the guide again.
